arms.label: Full context
arms.short: Whole document in the prompt, every query
arms.wins: Accuracy ceiling — the reference the others are read against
arms.breaks: Cost scales linearly with queries x document size

arms.label: Full context + cache (5 min)
arms.short: Same tokens, cached for five minutes
arms.wins: The cheapest write, if queries keep arriving inside the window
arms.breaks: Let the window lapse and the next query pays the write again

arms.label: Full context + cache (1 hour)
arms.short: Same tokens, cached for an hour
arms.wins: Full context's accuracy at roughly a tenth of the marginal cost
arms.breaks: Write costs 2x input, not 1.25x; still scales with document size

arms.label: Naive chunk RAG
arms.wins: Cheap, and flat in document size

arms.label: Hybrid + contextual
arms.short: BM25 + embeddings, LLM chunk prefixes, reranked
arms.wins: The honest RAG baseline; recovers most of naive RAG's losses
arms.breaks: A real indexing bill that scales with document size

arms.label: Agentic search
arms.short: Model gets grep and read over the document, iterates
arms.wins: Multi-hop, without the whole document in context
arms.breaks: Slowest by far, and cost varies per query

arms.label: Extract then query
arms.short: One map-reduce pass into a schema; queries hit the output
arms.wins: Near-zero marginal cost; unbeatable on aggregation
arms.breaks: Answers only what the schema anticipated

question_types.label: Needle
question_types.why: One passage contains the answer. Everything passes; this establishes the floor.

question_types.label: Multi-hop
question_types.why: Requires joining facts from distant sections. Retrieval usually gets one hop.

question_types.label: Aggregation
question_types.why: Requires seeing the whole document. Top-k retrieval structurally cannot.

question_types.label: Global
question_types.why: No single passage contains the answer; it is a property of the document.

question_types.label: Absent
question_types.why: The answer is not in the document. Tests refusal against hallucination.
